description: Chaotic voltage source simulating a multi-segment pendulum, running the same code as the Vult hardware module, with eight simulation models and eight interrelated outputs

params.text: Sets how fast the pendulum swings
Changes properties of the model such as gravity and mass, which makes the pendulum move more or less aggressively
Attenuates and inverts the SPEED input before it is added to the SPEED knob
Attenuates and inverts the ENERGY input before it is added to the ENERGY knob
Steps through the eight simulation models: Pendula, Planets, Fish Tank, Fluctuating Voltage, Coupled Oscillators, Feedback Dynamics, Analog Shift Register and Kicked Rotors
Sets a new initial position and new angular velocities, and pressed repeatedly it can make the pendulum rotate continuously
Reverses the angular velocities, so every segment moves the opposite way
Saves the current state of the pendulum
Returns the pendulum to the saved state

inputs.text: A trigger that sets a new initial position and new angular velocities
A trigger that reverses the angular velocities
A trigger that saves the current state of the pendulum
A trigger that returns the pendulum to the saved state
A control voltage added to the speed, scaled by the SPEED attenuverter
A clock that samples and holds the four X outputs, which turns the continuous movement into stepped voltages
A clock that samples and holds the four Y outputs, which turns the continuous movement into stepped voltages
A control voltage added to the energy, scaled by the ENERGY attenuverter

outputs.text: The horizontal position of that segment of the pendulum
The vertical position of that segment of the pendulum

menu: MODE — picks the simulation model directly: Pendula, Planets, Fish Tank, Fluctuating Voltage, Coupled Oscillators, Feedback Dynamics, Analog Shift Register or Kicked Rotors
